texts.af9c5c1108aa:
The British Women’s Heart and Health study is a major investigation into the geographical and behavioural risk factors for cardiovascular disease and other diseases in older women in Great Britain. The aim is to explain the marked regional differences in cardiovascular disease mortality in this country. It is supported by a grant from the British Heart Foundation and the Dof H. The study has approval from the Multi Regional Ethics Committee and the Patient Information Advisory Group to allow us to follow women up through their medical records.

Following Cardiovascular morbidity clearly depends on reports received from the GP and inevitably, many of our subjects will move without being able to provide the name of their new GP. We would be most grateful if you could help us by providing the name of the doctor with whom the following woman is now registered. We will then approach the GP by letter asking him to report a few specific cardiovascular events in exactly the same way as the previous GP has done.
